body.sub: 나에겐 너의 모든 비밀을 말해도 돼!
lines: Did you have a hard day?
Let your thoughts and feelings stay inside me.
Whisper to me — your joy, sadness, and dreams.
I listen to all your secrets, but I never tell them to others.
You can tell me anything.
I never judge — I just listen quietly.
Here’s the best part: You can go back to old times with me!
When you open me again, I’ll take you back to the past like a time machine.
I hold your laughter, tears, and lessons.
That’s how I help you keep your memories alive.
But be careful.
Keep me in a safe place so that others can’t read me.
What am I?
In many countries, schools have fun and surprising rules!
Let’s look at some of them.
In Sweden, students can eat snacks during class.
They eat fruit, nuts, or even sandwiches.
Snacks keep them happy and full of energy.
Many students like this rule.
Some schools in Canada let students bring pets on special days.
They can bring dogs, cats, rabbits, or parrots.
Teachers help keep the pets safe.
Students show their pets and have fun.
Chinese schools have a rule for after lunch.
Students rest or take naps at their desks.
Some schools have small beds.
This short break helps them feel refreshed and ready to learn.
Each school has different rules, but all of them make school more exciting.
Chameleons are amazing animals.
They can change their skin color to match their surroundings.
They also change color when it gets hot or cold.
Now, there is special paint that can do the same thing!
It changes color based on heat.
Tiny pieces inside the paint help make this happen.
If you spray it on a car, it becomes a chameleon car!
The color can look different in the morning and at night.
It doesn’t only work on cars.
You can also use it on things like your pen, bag, or even your smartphone.
You get new colors without using new paint.
If you get tired of the same color, try this fun paint and watch the magic happen!
